easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
